title: SectionViewStyle group-2 color and lineweight overlay insertion
scope: Preserve edits to typed SectionViewStyle plane/bend colors when the corresponding raw group-2 code-62 values are absent
Preserve edits to typed SectionViewStyle plane/bend lineweights when raw group-2 code-90 values are absent
Exercise the second lineweight ordinal with a default plane placeholder
Isolate the view-style control from the broader named-object callback selector

production: The same-version raw overlay now inserts missing group-2 code-62 plane/bend colors when their typed values differ from defaults.
The same-version raw overlay now inserts missing group-2 code-90 plane/bend lineweights when typed values change.
A changed bend value with a default/missing plane slot emits the plane placeholder first, preserving ordinal decoding.
tests: Generated ASCII and Binary controls remove the original group-2 color and lineweight groups, change both colors, retain the default plane lineweight, and change the bend lineweight.
The test compares the complete expected raw group sequence and verifies typed readback after same-version export/import.
Added --modeldoc-view-style-callbacks and dwg2dxf_modeldoc_view_style_callbacks for focused execution.

broaderNamedObjectSelector.result: fails earlier at the separate TABLE -> TABLESTYLE dictionary/carrier reference assertion; not treated as a pass or attributed to the isolated SectionViewStyle changes

limitations: This validates generated same-version raw-overlay preservation and local typed readback only. Autodesk's public SectionViewStyle API names the PlaneLineColor, BendLineColor, PlaneLineWeight, and BendLineWeight properties but does not establish the DXF group-2 occurrence schema. It does not qualify a native producer, cross-version serializer, native rendering, or external application behavior.
